integrity: The publisher PDF was inspected at the stochastic representation, density, CDF, Table 1, Corollary 2.1, heavy-tail proposition, and Figure 2. The correction follows independently from both the published CDF and the quotient representation. A standalone checker replays the formulas, table values, sign change, and tail limits.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects Corollary 2.1 and the tail argument that depends on its survival formula; it does not reassess the EM estimation procedure.
Table 1 and Figure 2 appear consistent with the corrected relation, but the authors' numerical implementation is unavailable.
A very recent or unindexed author correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: A sign error invalidates the printed SCHI reliability and hazard formulas
